description: Version updates of the gateway: images of compose.yaml and the Dockerfiles, Python dependencies (uv.lock), GitHub Actions (pinned to commit SHAs), pre-commit hooks. LiteLLM, Presidio and the libraries pinned to the images' versions move together.

packageRules.description: LiteLLM: image and Python package on the same version (the guardrail class extends its code, ADR-015)
Presidio: images and Python package on the same version (the unit tests run the recognizers on it)
Major versions need a reading of their upgrade notes
